1.consolidated_definition: Contestar, llamar. Hacer una llamada telefónica en respuesta a una recibida anteriormente. Calco de estructura, usual. Si deseas devolver la llamada y está ocupado, la red continuará intentando la comunicación durante 30 minutos (Puerto Rico Telephone Company, 23-07-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To respond to a call by making a return telephone call in response to one previously received. Calque of structure, usual. If you wish to return the call and it is busy, the network will continue attempting communication for 30 minutes (Puerto Rico Telephone Company, 23-07-07)
